error.interrupted: Interrupted. Groups finished so far are recorded in the apply log.
help.help: show this help message and exit
help.lang: screen language: en or ko (default: environment variable {env}, then LC_ALL / LC_MESSAGES / LANG, else en)
help.description: Find duplicate entities in a LightRAG knowledge graph, write a reviewable merge plan, and apply only the approved groups through LightRAG's own merge API. Unofficial tool.
help.epilog: Typical flow: scan -> review plan.csv -> apply (dry-run) -> apply --yes. Exit codes: 0 ok, 2 input/usage error, 3 plan does not match the graph, 4 a merge failed.
help.scan: read a working directory (read-only) and write a merge plan
help.scan_out: where to write the JSON plan (default: plan.json)
help.scan_csv: also write a one-row-per-member CSV for spreadsheet review
help.aliases: CSV with columns variant,canonical for spellings no rule can derive
help.workspace: LightRAG workspace sub-folder inside the working directory
help.near: trigram similarity threshold for review pairs, 0 to 1 (default: {default})
help.max_review: keep at most this many review pairs (default: {default})
help.explain: show why a node gets its key and which nodes share it
help.explain_name: node name exactly as stored in the graph
help.apply: apply the approved groups of a plan (dry-run unless --yes)
help.apply_long: Apply the groups marked apply=true in a plan.json or plan.csv. Without --yes nothing changes: you only see the calls that would be made.
help.apply_plan: plan.json or plan.csv written by scan (possibly edited)
help.apply_rag: Python path: FILE.py:FUNC or MODULE:FUNC returning your LightRAG instance (not initialized)
help.apply_server: server path: base URL of a running LightRAG server (API key from environment variable {env})
help.apply_working_dir: working directory used for the pre-check and the backup
help.apply_limit: apply only the first N pending groups
help.apply_no_backup: skip the backup (server path only, when the working directory is not reachable)
help.apply_log: progress log used to resume (default: apply-log.jsonl next to the plan)
help.restore: restore a working directory from a backup made by apply
help.restore_working_dir: folder to restore into (default: the folder recorded in the backup)
help.restore_yes: really restore (default only checks the backup)
help.restore_prune: also delete files created after the backup
help.demo: run the practice-mock demo (needs the lightrag extra)
scan.title: scan: {path} (read-only)
scan.review_truncated: review list was cut: {count} more pairs below the limit (raise --max-review)
scan.next: next: review {plan}, then run: lightrag-dedupe apply {plan} --working-dir <dir> (dry-run)
flag.type_conflict: type conflict: entity types differ, not merged by default
flag.near: near pair: similar spelling, check by hand
explain.name: name: {name}   entity_type: {entity_type}
explain.no_steps: no rule changed this name; its key is the name itself in letters and digits.
explain.same_key: other nodes with the same key:
explain.alone: no other node has this key.
explain.particle_graph: - the remaining stem exists as another node
explain.particle_alias: - the remaining stem is in the alias table
rule.nfkc: compatibility characters unified, e.g. full-width letters
rule.alias: replaced by the alias table's canonical spelling
rule.guard_too_short: guard: removing the suffix would leave too little, so the name was kept
apply.warn_sha_changed: warning: the graph changed since this plan was written; checking every source name now.
apply.header: plan: {total} groups to apply ({skipped} marked apply=false, {done} already done)
apply.preflight_ok: pre-check passed: every source exists in the graph exactly as written.
apply.preflight_skipped: pre-check skipped: give --working-dir (or --server) to verify the names first.
apply.rerun_hint: to apply for real, run the same command with --yes.
restore.dry_run: backup is intact: {files} files would be restored into {target} (backup: {backup}).
restore.stop_first: stop any LightRAG process or server that uses that folder first.
restore.rerun_hint: to restore for real, run the same command with --yes.
restore.extra: {count} files created after the backup were left in place (use --prune to delete them).
restore.pruned: {count} files created after the backup were deleted.
demo.banner: This is a practice mock: real LightRAG {version} runs offline with a one-token-per-character tokenizer and hash embeddings (no meaning), and an LLM that would raise if called. It works in a temporary folder only.
demo.step_build: 1) building a small knowledge graph from the bundled sample (no LLM) ...
demo.step_apply: 3) applying {count} approved groups through LightRAG's amerge_entities ...
demo.vdb: entity vector store: {before} -> {after} entries ({left} merged-away names left)
demo.relation: {target} -> {neighbor}: {count} relations became 1, weight {weight} (max rule, not the sum)
demo.rescan: 5) scan again: {groups} groups left, {auto} auto-apply candidates, {review} review pairs
demo.reminder: Never open your real working directory with mock embeddings: LightRAG refuses a different embedding model. Use --rag with your own factory or --server.
err.aliases_missing: alias file not found: {path}. Check the path or drop --aliases.
err.aliases_self: {path}: alias '{name}' maps to itself. Remove the row.
err.aliases_conflict: {path}: '{name}' is mapped to two different canonical names. Keep one row.
err.aliases_chain: {path}: '{name}' is a canonical name and also a variant of something else. Point the variants straight to the final name.
err.graph_missing: graph file not found: {path}. Pass the LightRAG working directory (it contains graph_chunk_entity_relation.graphml) or add --workspace.
err.graph_invalid: cannot read graph file {path}: {detail}. Is it a valid graphml file?
err.plan_missing: plan file not found: {path}. Run scan first.
err.plan_format: unsupported plan format '{found}' (expected '{expected}'). Re-run scan with this version.
err.plan_apply_value: {where}: apply must be true or false, got '{value}'.
err.plan_empty_target: {id}: target is empty. Fill in the name that should survive.
err.plan_empty_sources: {id}: no source names to merge. A group needs at least one member besides the target.
err.plan_target_in_sources: {id}: target '{name}' is also listed as a source. Remove it from the sources.
err.plan_overlap: '{name}' is used by both {a} and {b}. Set apply=false on one of them.
err.plan_csv_columns: plan.csv is missing columns: {missing}. Keep the header row written by scan.
err.plan_csv_inconsistent: {id}: rows disagree on column '{column}'. Give every row of the group the same value.
err.stale_source: {id}: node '{name}' is not in the graph ({count} missing in total). The plan is out of date; run scan again. Nothing was changed.
err.apply_no_backend: --yes needs a way to merge: add --rag FILE.py:FUNC (Python) or --server URL.
err.server_backup_required: refusing to change a server without a backup: add --working-dir (the server's data folder, reachable from here) or confirm with --no-backup.
err.backup_no_working_dir: no working directory known for the backup. Add --working-dir or --no-backup.
err.backup_manifest_missing: no manifest.json in {path}. Pass a folder created by apply.
err.backup_corrupt: backup file '{name}' is missing or does not match its sha256. The backup cannot be trusted.
err.restore_no_target: the backup does not record its source folder; add --working-dir.
err.server_url: invalid server URL '{url}'. Use e.g. http://localhost:9621.
err.server_busy: the server is busy (HTTP 409: documents are being indexed). Wait for indexing to finish, then run the same command again; finished groups are skipped. {detail}
err.server_unreachable: cannot reach {url}: {detail}. Is the LightRAG server running?
err.factory_spec: bad --rag value '{spec}'. Use FILE.py:FUNC or MODULE:FUNC.
err.factory_import: cannot import the factory '{spec}': {detail}. Install lightrag-hku in this environment (uv pip install "lightrag-dedupe[lightrag]").
err.factory_attr: '{name}' in '{spec}' is missing or not callable.
err.factory_result: the factory returned {type}, not a LightRAG instance (it needs amerge_entities and initialize_storages).
err.apply_failed: {id}: merge failed: {detail}. Groups finished before it are in the apply log; fix the cause and run again.
err.near_range: --near must be above 0 and at most 1 (got {value}).
err.explain_missing: no node named '{name}' in the graph. Use the name exactly as stored (see the scan output).
err.extra_missing: this needs LightRAG. Install it with: uv pip install "lightrag-dedupe[lightrag]" (or uv tool install "lightrag-dedupe[lightrag]").
err.sample_missing: bundled sample files not found. Reinstall the package or run from a repository checkout.
err.not_utf8: {path} is not UTF-8 text. Save it as "CSV UTF-8" in your spreadsheet app and run again.
err.write_failed: cannot write {path}: {detail}. Check that the folder exists and is writable.
err.factory_import_user: cannot import the factory '{spec}': {detail}. Run lightrag-dedupe from the same Python environment as your LightRAG app (the factory imports {module}).
